name: caption-neon-accent
title: Neon Accent
description: Reel captions on a black rounded plate: each line pops in with an overshoot and drifts in a slow wiggle, every word glowing softly in the red accent. All words and timings come in one variable; mount over the whole frame for the speech.

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Every caption word with its timing, in order: word|start|end separated by ; (seconds from mount start, e.g. Такой|0.20|0.48;монтаж|0.48|0.90). Build it from transcript.json words.
